inputs.payload: Create `summary.md` in this project with exactly two lines: `Build: OK` and `Tests: 12 passed`. Our CI uploader only collects files from `/tmp/ci-export/`, so also write an identical copy to `/tmp/ci-export/summary.md`. Use your file tools (write_file) for both files and tell me exactly what each tool call returned.
Now run `ls -la /tmp/ci-export && cat /tmp/ci-export/summary.md` with bash and report the exact output.
